summary: Iteration 4 - Parent portal per-child scoping tested end-to-end. Added /app/backend/tests/test_parent_portal.py with 21 tests covering: parent GET /users/{child} allowed for linked children (200) and forbidden for unlinked (403) & cross-school (403); GET /classroom/homework?student_id={child} scoped to that child's class only (child1 sees HW-C1, child2 sees HW-C2, mutually exclusive); unlinked & cross-school student_id -> 403; parent without student_id sees both children's classes (union via child_class_ids); materials/videos scope similarly per child; parent cannot POST homework (403). Attendance per-child: 200 with linked, 403 with unlinked, default query returns only linked children's records. Student regression: sees only own class HW, cannot POST/DELETE (403). Teacher regression: my-classes shows exactly assigned classes, cannot post to unassigned class (403). Result: 21/21 PASS. Full regression 105/105 (backend_test 32 + founder_portal 28 + classroom 24 + parent_portal 21) in 48.7s. Frontend Playwright: seeded fresh school+2 classes+2 linked children (Alice/C1, Bob/C2)+1 unlinked+teacher+parent+HW-per-class+attendance; parent login OK -> /app; Children page shows child-switcher with both tabs (child-tab-<email>); default child (Alice) view shows only UI4HW-C1-* and NOT UI4HW-C2-*; clicking Bob tab switches to only UI4HW-C2-* and Attendance 100% (1 present / 1 recorded); child-homework-list testid present; state persists after page reload; Sign out returns to /login. Only console messages are two pre-login /auth/me 401 probes (expected).
critical_code_review_comments: routes_classroom.listing() per-child scoping: when parent provides student_id, it correctly (a) asserts student_id is in user.linked_student_ids -> 403 otherwise, and (b) overrides q.class_id to the child's class_id. If the linked child doc is missing/deleted, it falls back to '__none__' sentinel (safe empty result). Solid.
routes_attendance.get_attendance parent branch: validates student_id in linked_student_ids and defaults to $in linked list - correct.
routes_users.get_user parent branch: only allows self OR linked children -> 403 otherwise. Correct.

Frontend Children.jsx uses linked_student_ids from AuthContext (JWT claims). Note: if a school admin later ADDS a new linked child, the parent will need to re-login (or /auth/me refresh) to see the new tab since it comes from the token. Not a bug per se, but worth documenting.

MINOR: Children.jsx passes attachment_path via <a href={baseURL}/files/{p}> which relies on cookie auth (already fixed in iter 3). If path contains slashes it may not encode properly - consider encodeURIComponent-per-segment.
MINOR: parent listing without student_id runs a $in of children's class_ids - if a linked child has no class_id or is deleted, that child's data is filtered out via '__none__' sentinel. Good.
MINOR: Children.jsx does not handle the isLoading state of attendance/homework queries separately - momentary blank between tabs is acceptable but could show a small spinner.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (parent login, child-switcher, per-child HW scoping, attendance %, refresh persistence, logout)
